- ADV-04 adv04_settlement_receipt_forgery.sql: settlement receipt with wrong sha256, receipt bound to another owner/permit/shot/result kind, scored receipt without release-policy lineage all refused; same-bytes replay = accepted, different policy / absent receipt replay = shot.receipt_mismatch; client cannot insert/update/delete receipts or read another account's receipt.
- ADV-05 adv05_anon_and_other_user_surface.sql: anon holds no EXECUTE on any public/api_private function and no table privilege; API key with no JWT sub -> auth.required/raise and empty reads on every table; other signed-in account sees 0 owner rows on every table (offline devices/grants/ledger, receipts, tombstones, permits, shots, sessions, profiles, consent, evaluation, feedback, deletion feedback) and cannot write rows naming the owner.
- ADV-06 adv06_api_gate_session_matrix.sql: wrong / missing x-pickle-api-key -> every table reads 0 rows, every write and every client RPC refused, no row written; right key + no/garbage/foreign/expired/revoked session or banned account -> the 4 offline RPCs raise 42501 (offline devices/ledger row counts unchanged), un-banning re-admits. - ADV-07 adv07_permit_lifecycle_client_grant.sql: client column grants on analysis_permits are exact (status/outcome only); terminal permits (finalized/released/partial) cannot reopen; partial terminal outcome consumes nothing; owner DELETE of a settled permit is refused, a released one tombstones; a tombstoned id cannot be resurrected; reusing the idempotency key after owner deletion creates a NEW row (never revives the id), keeps the tombstone and access_state stays (f,1,1).
- ADV-08 adv08_offline_conservation_no_reclaim.sql: allocation is a hold not a consumption; released ticket still counts; consumed ticket cannot be consumed with another shot or released back; holds + online reservations + lifetime scored never exceed 2 across a 2nd installation, an online reservation and a re-issued generation; ledger append-only for client, service_role and owner; Pro lease = min(now+7d, entitlement expiry), expired entitlement does not lease; account deletion keeps the ledger and the same identity on a fresh account still owes the holds; issue_offline_grant refuses ticket counts outside 0..2; release_offline_ticket refuses 'support_review' from a client.
